_about: Hard requirements between the list's entries, by Nexus mod id (modId: [modIds it needs]). Used by `ultimate.sh install --available`, which installs only the files already in the downloads folder: an entry is left out when anything it needs is left out. SKSE = 30379, Address Library = 32444. ESP masters are checked again after the install (missing masters are reported).
_entries: Entries that are patches for another entry of the same mod page need their base file too.
